title: Ordinary mixed prime-field tensor functor on etale sheaves
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\ell$ be a natural number, and put $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/\ell\mathbf Z$ (the prime field when $\ell$ is prime). Let $A$ be a commutative $\Lambda$-algebra and $N$ an $A$-module. On the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], define the functor from $\Lambda$-module sheaves to $A$-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] by sheafifying the sectionwise mixed tensor [def-pc-mixed-total-tensor]: $F\mapsto a(U\mapsto N\otimes_A(A\otimes_\Lambda F(U)))$. On morphisms apply the mixed tensor sectionwise and sheafify. Thus its value is the ordinary sheaf tensor $N_X\otimes_{\Lambda_X}F$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], with $A$ acting through $N$, with no derived tensor or finiteness hypothesis on $N$.
